cards.why: D-1, repair of the house: FEMA denied 21,300 dollars as a duplication because it had no settlement letter; Hearthguard paid 14,000 dollars and its letter in the mail (M-4) shows the policy's water-damage limit was reached, so 21,300 less 14,000 is 7,300 dollars unpaid, an unmet need after insurance. Appeal by Monday 19 October 2026, 60 days from the letter of 20 August

D-2, personal property: FEMA denied 6,250 dollars as insured; Hearthguard paid 4,100 and its letter (M-4) shows the contents limit was reached, so 6,250 less 4,100 is 2,150 dollars unpaid. Appeal by Monday 19 October 2026, 60 days from the letter of 20 August
